themes.title: Themes
themes.intro: Choose how CouchDesk looks and sounds. Changes apply right away.
themes.builtin.salon.sub: Light and warm, like a living room in the evening.
themes.builtin.noche.sub: Dark and calm, for playing in low light.
themes.builtin.cine.sub: Very dark and crisp. Made for big TVs.
themes.builtin.bosque.sub: Deep green and cream, with a touch of amber.
themes.builtin.alto-contraste.sub: Bold text and a yellow focus. Easier to read.
themes.create.sub: Pick colours, font, background and music.
themes.import.sub: Use a theme someone shared with you.
themes.name: Name
themes.background.pick.sub: Image, video or YouTube. Then come back and pick “Current background”.
themes.music.url: Link to an MP3 or OGG, or a YouTube video or playlist
themes.music.hint: CouchDesk music is made live and never repeats the same way.
themes.music.toggle.sub: Only plays when CouchDesk is in front.
themes.music.when: It goes quiet when you open a game, the browser or Spotify. It comes back on its own.
themes.error.name: Give the theme a name.
themes.error.hex: That colour won't work. Type it like this: #E8643A.
themes.delete.sub: This can't be undone. If it's in use, Living Room comes back.
themes.share.sub: Copy this code and pass it on. On another CouchDesk, go to Themes → Import theme.
themes.share.copyFail: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
themes.import.intro: Paste a theme code or open its file.
themes.import.bad: That code isn't a CouchDesk theme.
themes.import.noClipboard: Couldn't read what you copied. Paste the code in the box.
themes.saver.sound.sub: Sea, wind, rain or fire, to match the scene.
themes.saver.windows.sub: Windows will also show it when you're not using CouchDesk.
themes.win.title: Make CouchDesk your Windows
themes.win.intro: A few optional steps. Everything can be undone.
themes.win.saver.sub: Windows shows it outside the console too.
themes.win.signin: Sign in without the lock screen
themes.win.signin.sub: Opens the Windows sign-in options. You decide there.
themes.win.optimize.sub: Turns off services the console doesn't use. Windows will ask for permission.
themes.win.optimize.started: Accept the Windows prompt. When it's done, restart the PC.
